description: Classify a batch of blockchain transactions (up to 100) using CryptoTaxEdge's classification engine. Built for accounting platforms integrating CryptoTaxEdge as their classification layer. Returns per-transaction: category (the open vocabulary the engine emits, for example swap, transfer, staking, reward, airdrop, income_receipt, fee_payment, borrow, repay, collateral_supply, collateral_withdraw, liquidity_add, liquidity_remove, wrap, unwrap, liquid_staking_mint, bridge_transfer, nft_mint, spam, unclassified; the full set with house treatments is at https://cryptotaxedge.com/standard/#categories and grows additively, so branch exhaustive logic on treatment, never on category), treatment (closed enum: disposal, income, non_taxable, expense, needs_review; needs_review means no treatment is asserted), tax_category (the engine's stored treatment value, kept for existing hosts), taxable, confidence score, needs_review, ledger_action, protocol, description (plain-English reasoning, also returned as explanation for existing clients), assets (sent, received, gas) and a reliability envelope with an explicit route-to-review flag, plus block_time and block_number. A multi-step lending transaction (Morpho Blue, Aave V3) additionally returns a per-leg breakdown (legs) and a summary (memo). Pass prices: true for an indicative USD value per asset and a valuation block. EVM + Solana. Rules for using the answer: never book a row whose needs_review is true, and never treat legs as a verdict (they are a proposal for a reviewer and do not change the row). A row that carries error was not classified: it is not a review decision, so fix or resend the input. Pass engagement_id / firm_id to apply firm-specific classification policy when configured.

engagement_id.description: (Optional) host-side engagement identifier. Reserved for firm-policy + engagement-record correlation. No effect today; forward-compatible.

firm_id.description: (Optional) host-side firm identifier. When firm classification policy is configured, applies that firm's confidence thresholds + CoA overrides.

prices.description: (Optional) true to add an indicative USD value to each asset: usd_price and usd_value on every leg that can be priced, at the market price near the block time, plus a valuation block. Not a cost basis. Assets with no usable quote are left without a value and listed with a reason.

transactions.description: Array of transactions to classify (max 100 per call).

chain.description: Chain slug (e.g. "ethereum", "polygon", "bsc", "arbitrum", "base", "optimism", "avalanche", "solana"). Optional; CryptoTaxEdge auto-detects the chain if omitted.

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash (0x-prefixed 66-char for EVM, base-58 for Solana).

tx_id.description: (Optional) your own ID for this tx; echoed back so you can correlate results to your records.

wallet.description: (Optional) One 0x-prefixed EVM address to read every transaction in this batch from. Sent and received are then reported from this address instead of from the transaction sender. Use it when the books belong to someone other than the sender, for example the recipient of a transfer or of a bridge payout. An address that took no part in the transaction gives a review row. To say which addresses share an owner, use wallets.

wallets.description: (Optional) Up to 50 0x-prefixed EVM wallet addresses that belong to the same owner as the books. A transfer between two wallets on this list is served as an own-wallet movement (non-taxable); without the list every plain transfer is routed to review. Include the sending wallet.

name: classify_batch

assets.description: Net asset movements, same shape as REST /v1: sent and received legs plus the gas leg (null when not attributable). Present when the engine response carries them.

block_number.description: The block (or Solana slot) the transaction was mined in.

block_time.description: When the transaction was mined, UTC. Absent when it could not be read.

category.description: Canonical category. Open vocabulary that only grows additively; tolerate unfamiliar values and branch exhaustive logic on treatment instead. Full set with house treatments: https://cryptotaxedge.com/standard/#categories

confidence.description: Routing signal, not an accuracy claim. 0 on a row that carries error: no verdict exists.

description.description: Plain-English reasoning for the verdict, same field as REST /v1.

error.description: Present only on a row the engine did not classify (invalid_hash, tx_not_retrievable, batch_budget_exhausted and similar). Such a row is not a verdict: do not post it and do not treat it as a review decision; fix or retry the input.

example_tx_hash.description: Contract-and-selector lookups only: the classified transaction this general answer was taken from. It is not a transaction of yours.

explanation.description: Deprecated alias of description, kept for existing clients.

hash.description: The transaction hash this row answers.

ledger_action.description: Suggested ledger label for posting, same field as REST /v1.

legs.description: Only when the receipt shows this wallet changing a lending position in two or more steps: one leg per event (flash_loan, supply_collateral, withdraw_collateral, borrow, repay) and a swap when market prices confirm one, each with role, category, treatment, taxable, asset and basis (event or derived). A proposal for the reviewer; it does not change the verdict.

lookup.description: contract_function on a contract-and-selector lookup. Absent on a transaction answer.

memo.description: Present with legs: a plain-English summary of them.

note.description: Contract-and-selector lookups only: what the answer is and is not.

review_note.description: Why a review row was routed to a human.

treatment.description: Closed five-value tax treatment enum, safe to switch on exhaustively. needs_review means no treatment is asserted.

tx_hash.description: Same value as hash, kept for existing clients.

tx_id.description: Batch rows: your row id echoed back.

valuation.description: Only when prices: true was passed: what the usd_value figures on the legs are (currency, as_of, priced and unpriced leg counts, and a reason for each unpriced leg). Indicative market prices, not a cost basis.

title: Classify transaction batch
